########################################################################
# Include python install macros
########################################################################
include(GrPython)
if(NOT PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    return()
endif()

add_subdirectory(bindings)

########################################################################
# Install python sources
########################################################################
gr_python_install(FILES __init__.py
    ofdm_parse_mac.py
    ofdm_sync_short.py
    ofdm_sync_long.py
    ofdm_equalize_symbols.py
    ofdm_decode_signal.py
    ofdm_decode_mac.py DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/mywifi)

########################################################################
# Handle the unit tests
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

set(GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-mywifi)

# Create a package directory that tests can import. It includes everything
# from `python/`.
add_custom_target(
    copy_module_for_tests ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test_modules/gnuradio/mywifi/)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_parse_mac ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_parse_mac.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_sync_short ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_sync_short.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_sync_long ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_sync_long.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_equalize_symbols ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_equalize_symbols.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_decode_signal ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_decode_signal.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_decode_mac ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_decode_mac.py)
